# Firecrawl discovery — fixture adapter

This is BellLabs fixture guidance, not a copy of the workstation CLI/build skills. Read
`/skills/report-source-procedure/references/START_HERE.md`. Use only tools advertised by the host and their actual input schemas.
The historical MCP snapshot is reference data, not a verified server schema or admission.

Use search for an unknown source; use a single-page scrape only to inspect a selected URL.
Prefer primary model documentation. Inspect source identity/version and distinguish total
from active parameter counts. Do not launch crawling, extraction agents or browser sessions
for this two-source question. Share the three-query/three-capture budget with Tavily.

Preserve provider results and selected/omitted reasons through the configured KS discovery
receipt route. Direct provider calls are imported as self-reported; managed KS discovery
must be host-dispatched and is a separate route. Do not run both routes for the same attempt.
Record blocked pages, redirects, timeouts and ambiguous results without claiming absence.

A Firecrawl preview is not KS-captured evidence. Capture selected URLs through the admitted
KS capture service, then inspect those exact bytes and locate quotes. Never construct a
capture receipt, digest or support verdict from scraper output. Missing tools or custody
configuration must remain explicit preflight blockers. Do not install or authenticate CLIs.
